SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources WHERE type = 'journal' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did PJM or MISO generate more electricity from coal in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_coal AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority IN ('PJM', 'MISO') AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which particles turn up most often among decay products in the Particle Data Group tables?
SELECT name AS particle, count(*) AS appearances FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgdecay WHERE is_outgoing = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the blood–brain barrier set are known to cross into the brain?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bbbp WHERE p_np = 1
Which universities and hospitals lead the most clinical trials?
SELECT name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_sponsors WHERE class = 'OTHER' AND role = 'lead' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the U.S. average diesel price in the week of June 20, 2022?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.EMD_EPD2D_PTE_NUS_DPG.W' AND period = '20220620'
Which customs districts handled the most U.S. exports in 2024?

SELECT x.dist_name, sum(try_cast(d.all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_exports_district AS x ON x.dist_code = d.district WHERE d.year = '2024' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Are patent citations more often added by applicants or by examiners?
SELECT citation_category, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which utilities earned the most revenue from commercial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(revenues_1 AS double) AS commercial_thousand_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average weekly wage for private-sector workers in Brooklyn in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT avg_wkly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36047' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1'
How many public schools receive Title I funding, by kind of programme?
SELECT titlei_status_text, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_129 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many clinical trial sites are recruiting patients now?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_locations WHERE status = 'RECRUITING'
What kinds of tax-exempt organisation are most common?

SELECT CASE cast(subsection AS varchar) WHEN '3' THEN '501(c)(3) charity' WHEN '4' THEN '501(c)(4) social welfare' WHEN '5' THEN '501(c)(5) labour or agricultural' WHEN '6' THEN '501(c)(6) business league' WHEN '7' THEN '501(c)(7) social club' WHEN '8' THEN '501(c)(8) fraternal society' WHEN '19' THEN '501(c)(19) veterans group' ELSE '501(c)(' || cast(subsection AS varchar) || ')' END AS kind, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When was the first patent application in the file published?
Where was unemployment lowest among the states at the end of 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many final rules were published each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(issue_date, 2, 4) AS year, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE doc_type = '"RULE"' AND substr(issue_date, 2, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What share of hazardous waste enforcement actions does EPA take, rather than the states?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN trim(enforcement_agency) = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements
Which countries supplied the most smartphones to the United States in 2023?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.gen_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_imports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '851713%' AND d.year = '2023' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, how many days of extra patent term do patents get for USPTO delays?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which balancing authorities oversee the most power plants?
SELECT balancing_authority_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE balancing_authority_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much energy did New York State consume in 2023, in billion Btu?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.TETCB.NY.A' AND period = '2023'
How many wind turbines went into service each year from 2013 to 2022?
SELECT p_year, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE try_cast(p_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What were the combined year-end net assets reported on Schedule H?
SELECT sum(try_cast(net_assets_eoy_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_h
How many particles in the Particle Data Group tables are electrically neutral?
SELECT count(*) AS particles FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle WHERE try_cast(charge AS double) = 0
Which congressional districts are the most compact in land area?
SELECT usps || '-' || substr(geoid, 3, 2) AS district, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_120cds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent WHERE c0 = '2519'
Which categories of medical equipment reach the most Medicare patients?
Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Devices Supplies By Geography And Service

SELECT rbcs_desc AS category, sum(try_cast(tot_suplr_benes AS double)) AS beneficiaries FROM govblock_health.medicare_durable_medical_equipment_devices_supplies_by_geography_and_service WHERE rfrg_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_durable_medical_equipment_devices_supplies_by_geography_and_service) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the WTI crude oil spot price on April 20, 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' AND period = '20200420'
Which utility territories have the most recorded solar installations?

SELECT utility_service_territory, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE utility_service_territory <> '-1' AND utility_service_territory IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many days did a New York hospital stay last on average in 2016?
SELECT avg(try_cast(length_of_stay AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016'
Under which approval pathways are listed drugs marketed?
SELECT marketing_category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE marketing_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How is serotonin written as a SMILES string?
SELECT c1 AS smiles FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_smiles WHERE c0 = '5202'
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many CRS reports in the library mention China in their titles?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%china%'
Which operating nuclear reactors have the largest generating capacity?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, try_cast(capacity_mwe AS double) AS mwe FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were private-sector weekly wages higher in Manhattan or San Francisco in the third quarter of 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT CASE area_fips WHEN '36061' THEN 'Manhattan' ELSE 'San Francisco' END AS county, try_cast(avg_wkly_wage AS double) AS weekly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips IN ('36061', '06075') AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND year = '2023' AND qtr = '3'
Which New York counties have the highest average rent paid by subsidized tenants?

SELECT name, try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) AS rent_per_month FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE states = 'NY New York' AND program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the average in-state tuition and fees at public colleges that mainly award bachelor's degrees?
SELECT avg(try_cast(tuitionfee_in AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(preddeg AS varchar) = '3'
Which fields of technology have the most published patent applications?
SELECT wipo_field_title AS field, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_wipo_technology WHERE wipo_field_sequence = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
